name: Windsor.ai
summary: Windsor.ai is a data integration platform with over 350 sources. Its hosted MCP server lets your AI query Search Console next to GA4, Google Ads and more.
signIn: Sign in to Windsor.ai, connect Search Console once and pick the property, then add Windsor in the assistant: from Claude's connector directory, as a ChatGPT plugin, or by URL in Claude Code.
free: 30-day free trial (1 user, 10 data sources, 15 accounts, 30-day history limit), then a Forever Free plan with 1 user, 1 data source and 1 account. No credit card needed.
price: Basic $19 a month billed annually or $23 monthly (3 sources). Standard $99 annually or $118 monthly (7 sources). Plus $249 annually or $299 monthly (10 sources). Professional $499 annually or $598 monthly (14 sources). Enterprise by quote.
writeActions: Read-only for Search Console, per its Search Console MCP page, with no URL inspection and read-only sitemaps. Its pricing page says write functions such as pausing campaigns or adjusting budgets are on every plan for other sources.
dataStorage: Not stated for Search Console data. Its pricing FAQ says it refreshes a data cache every 6 hours and its servers are in Germany.
history: Its Search Console page cites Google's 16 months for Search Analytics. Its pricing page lists up to 10 years of data history on all plans, and a 30-day limit during the free trial.
pickIf: You want Search Console next to Google Ads and other paid channels in one connector.
You want extra Search Console fields such as words in a query and URL path levels.
You want to add it from Claude's connector directory or as a ChatGPT plugin.
